I have created the historical visual study reconstruction of the Lamborghini English homepage (`lamborghini.com/en-en`, observed 2026-10-06) as an interactive, production-grade desktop design (`1280x720` baseline).

### Key Architectural & Design Implementations:
1. **Typography & Styling (`LamboType Variable`)**:
   - Integrated the official `Lambotype-Variable.woff` font.
   - Applied wide uppercase eyelet headers (`font-stretch: 110%`, tracking `0.18em-0.25em`) alongside the 120px condensed uppercase model display titles (`font-stretch: 55%`).
   - Implemented the sharp rectangular monochrome button styles (`sharp-btn-white`, `sharp-btn-black`, and fine outline states).
2. **Fixed Header (104px)**:
   - Centered official white bull SVG insignia, left `MENU` trigger, and right hairline search icon.
   - Dynamically transitions from a subtle dark gradient to opaque charcoal (`#121316`) on scroll.
3. **Revuelto SV Campaign Hero (720px tall)**:
   - Displays the hero campaign with the original poster media, official video stream link (`m3u8`), dark gradient overlays, and exact typography (`THE QUANTUM OF DRIVING` at 27px, `REVUELTO SV` at 120px condensed).
   - Rectangular `DISCOVER MORE` action directing to `/en-en/models/revuelto-models/revuelto-sv`.
4. **Range & Family Carousel**:
   - Full family sequence in verified order: **Revuelto**, **Urus**, and **Temerario**.
   - Includes authentic family wordmarks, official cutout photography, and campaign slogans (`URUS AT ITS PEAK`, `YOU CAN'T HIDE WHO YOU ARE`).
   - Interactive hexagon next/previous arrows and functional tabs for sub-models with actions (`Explore the model`, `Start configuration`, `Enquire`).
   - Verified WLTP fuel consumption and emissions compliance disclaimer block.
5. **Dealer Locator Band**:
   - Full-width art banner with dark treatment and direct locator navigation.
6. **Configurator Chooser**:
   - Complete sub-model tabs (`REVUELTO SV`, `URUS SE PERFORMANTE`, `TEMERARIO`, `REVUELTO`, `URUS SE`) with real configurator deep links and cutout studio assets.
7. **Complete Charcoal Footer & Legal Framework**:
   - Verified directory links, vector social marks, WLTP environmental footnotes, and the original warning regarding unlawful share offers.
8. **Navigation Overlay**:
   - Primary and secondary site hierarchy with Escape key and toggle interaction.

designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system embodies uncompromising automotive engineering, raw mechanical power, and high-fashion editorial restraint. Engineered specifically for a hand-held mobile viewport, the interface mirrors the experience of operating a modern Italian hypercar: ultra-precise, stark, commanding, and stripped of ornamental excess.

### Aesthetic Paradigm
- **Monochrome Brutalism & Haute Editorial**: Grounded in pure pitch black and clinical stark white, punctuated exclusively by surgical graphite structural rules and rare, razor-sharp Giallo/Oro metallic accents.
- **Aggressive Aerodynamic Tension**: Every element is taut, deliberate, and geometric. Borders feel machined; typography is compressed and athletic; spacing is hyper-disciplined.
- **Tactile Precision**: Interaction elements simulate high-tolerance physical cockpit switchgear—instant state snaps, mechanical haptics, hairline borders, and zero ambient blur.
- **Target Audience**: Ultra-high-net-worth collectors, track performance drivers, and design purists demanding immediate telemetry clarity, cinematic vehicle storytelling, and frictionless bespoke configuration.

## Layout & Spacing

Layout geometry is optimized strictly for a 390px baseline mobile viewport (iPhone 14/15/16 Pro standard), enforcing a disciplined, rhythmic vertical cadence.

### Mobile-First Single Column Architecture
- **Viewport Lock**: The experience is strictly single column. Lateral scrolling is prohibited except for dedicated horizontal vehicle telemetry wheels or swipeable bespoke trim swatches.
- **Canvas Edge Margins**: Consistent 20px (`1.25rem`) padding on outer horizontal edges ensures no structural component or dynamic label touches the screen bezel.
- **Grid & Gutters**: Internal modules, specification tables, and split stat indicators use a 2-column or 4-column sub-grid bounded by 16px (`1rem`) gutters.
- **Vertical Spacing Cadence**:
  - `space-xs` (4px): Micro padding between badge icons and technical status tags.
  - `space-sm` (8px): Distance between metadata subtitles and parent headlines.
  - `space-md` (16px): Standard internal padding for cards, switch inputs, and telemetry rows.
  - `space-lg` (24px): Gap separating grouped functional modules.
  - `space-xl` (40px): Section breaks separating narrative chapters, visualizer stages, and vehicle systems.

## Elevation & Depth

This system outright rejects soft blurred shadows, skeuomorphic drops, and organic diffuse elevations. Visual depth is realized strictly through **structural surface tiers and 1px hairline graphite divisions**.

### Depth Layers
- **Tier 0 (Foundation)**: `#000000` — Canvas, full-bleed vehicle photography backdrops, immersive editorial video canvases.
- **Tier 1 (Panels & Trays)**: `#0B0B0B` with `border: 1px solid #222222`. Used for configuration trays, engine spec cards, and persistent bottom bars.
- **Tier 2 (Floating Cockpit Switches)**: `#141414` with `border: 1px solid #333333`. Elevated controls, toggle groups, and active modal overlays.

### Light Emission & Glow
- Zero blur shadows under resting surfaces.
- Active states and drive-mode engagement (e.g., CORSA mode) utilize a surgical 1px luminous border of `#D4AF37` or `#E02424` accompanied by a strictly restrained 0 0 12px perimeter accent glow at 35% opacity.

## Components

### Buttons & Cockpit Switches
- **Primary Launch Button (Hero CTA)**:
  - Background: `#FFFFFF`; Text: `#000000`, Barlow Condensed Bold, Uppercase, 14px, tracking `0.1em`.
  - Height: 52px full-width single column.
  - Cut: Optional 8px opposing chamfer corners.
  - Active State: Immediate snap to `#D4AF37` background with zero transition latency, providing an instant tactile feedback impression.
- **Secondary Telemetry Button**:
  - Background: `#000000`; Border: `1px solid #222222`; Text: `#FFFFFF`.
  - Hover/Press State: Border illuminates to `#FFFFFF` with background shifting to `#141414`.
- **Ghost/Tertiary Action**:
  - Background: Transparent; Border: None; Text: `#8E8E93` in `JetBrains Mono`. Includes a trailing directional glyph (`->`).

### Input Fields & Selectors
- **Technical Specification Inputs**:
  - Background: `#0B0B0B`; Border: `1px solid #222222`; Text: `#FFFFFF`.
  - Height: 48px.
  - Active/Focus: Border turns to `#D4AF37`. Floating labels render in 9px `JetBrains Mono` uppercase above the entry field with letter spacing `0.15em`.

### Chips & Drive Mode Badges
- **Cockpit Chips (STRADA / SPORT / CORSA)**:
  - Layout: Horizontal 3-way segmented switch spanning the 390px baseline.
  - Inactive: `#000000` fill, `1px solid #222222` outline, `#8E8E93` monospace text.
  - Active: `#141414` fill, `1px solid #D4AF37` (or `#E02424` for Corsa mode), crisp white text with a preceding 4px square status beacon.

### Cards & Telemetry Containers
- **Modular Data Cells**:
  - Structure: Bordered rectangles in `#0B0B0B` with `1px solid #222222`.
  - Content Flow: Top row features metric title in `label-sm` muted aluminum; center displays primary numeric readout (e.g., `3.2 SEC`, `770 CV`, `8,500 RPM`) in `headline-lg` titanium white; bottom houses micro-graph or legal homologation disclaimer.

### Checkboxes & Toggle Switches
- **Tactile Toggle Switch**:
  - Form: Rectangular horizontal slider (48px × 24px) with a 0px radius square thumb (20px × 20px).
  - Track: `#141414` with a `1px solid #222222` border.
  - Thumb Active: Snaps flush to the right margin with `#D4AF37` fill.
- **Hexagonal/Square Checkbox**:
  - Size: 18px × 18px square with 1px border. Checked state displays a solid white square inner pip (8px × 8px) with zero border smoothing.

### List Modules & Spec Breakdown
- **Telemetry Readout Rows**:
  - Height: 44px minimum touch surface.
  - Structure: Key-value pair separated by a horizontal dotted baseline or 1px border-bottom in `#222222`.
  - Left: Technical spec title in `body-sm` (`#8E8E93`).
  - Right: Metric value in `label-md` (`#FFFFFF`).

### Authentic Legal Disclaimer Display
- Positioned strictly pinned to bottom container tiers or footer segments.
- Typography: 8px `JetBrains Mono`, uppercase, `#555555` color tone.
- Encapsulated within a full-width container with a hairline top border (`#1A1A1A`), accompanied by official manufacturer certification codenames and consumption emission classification tables (WLTP standards).

- **Dividers & Structural Rules (Machined Graphite)**: `#222222` — Precise 1px borders providing structure without optical weight.
- **Typography Primary (Pure Titanium)**: `#FFFFFF` — High-visibility data readouts, primary action labels, and high-impact condensed headlines.
- **Typography Secondary (Muted Aluminum)**: `#8E8E93` — Metadata, technical specs, vehicle stats, and legal disclaimers.
- **Primary Accent (Giallo/Oro Metallico)**: `#D4AF37` — Reserved strictly for focal status beacons, active vehicle modes, drive-selector toggles, and primary conversion triggers. Must never exceed 5% total viewport coverage.

## Brand & Style

This design system embodies uncompromising automotive engineering, raw mechanical power, and high-fashion editorial restraint. Engineered specifically for a hand-held mobile viewport, the interface mirrors the experience of operating a modern Italian hypercar: ultra-precise, stark, commanding, and stripped of ornamental excess.

### Aesthetic Paradigm
- **Monochrome Brutalism & Haute Editorial**: Grounded in pure pitch black and clinical stark white, punctuated exclusively by surgical graphite structural rules and rare, razor-sharp Giallo/Oro metallic accents.
- **Aggressive Aerodynamic Tension**: Every element is taut, deliberate, and geometric. Borders feel machined; typography is compressed and athletic; spacing is hyper-disciplined.
- **Tactile Precision**: Interaction elements simulate high-tolerance physical cockpit switchgear—instant state snaps, mechanical haptics, hairline borders, and zero ambient blur.
- **Target Audience**: Ultra-high-net-worth collectors, track performance drivers, and design purists demanding immediate telemetry clarity, cinematic vehicle storytelling, and frictionless bespoke configuration.

## Colors

The color palette is built on strict binary high-contrast fundamentals, utilizing absolute black to preserve OLED power efficiency and create infinite depth, contrasted with raw titanium white and precision-milled metallic accents.

### Core Swatches
- **Base Canvas (Obsidian Black)**: `#000000` — Pure absolute black for screen immersion, backdrop, and total structural contrast.
- **Cockpit Tier 1 (Surface Graphite)**: `#0B0B0B` — Subtle matte surface lift for interactive modules and secondary cards.
- **Cockpit Tier 2 (Panel Charcoal)**: `#141414` — Elevated containers, telemetry overlays, and modal sheets.
- **Dividers & Structural Rules (Machined Graphite)**: `#222222` — Precise 1px borders providing structure without optical weight.
- **Typography Primary (Pure Titanium)**: `#FFFFFF` — High-visibility data readouts, primary action labels, and high-impact condensed headlines.
- **Typography Secondary (Muted Aluminum)**: `#8E8E93` — Metadata, technical specs, vehicle stats, and legal disclaimers.
- **Primary Accent (Giallo/Oro Metallico)**: `#D4AF37` — Reserved strictly for focal status beacons, active vehicle modes, drive-selector toggles, and primary conversion triggers. Must never exceed 5% total viewport coverage.
- **Telemetry Critical (Corsa Rosso)**: `#E02424` — Dedicated redline alerts, rev limits, track telemetry warnings, and emergency disclaimers.

## Typography

The typographic hierarchy is designed as an architectural instrument, delivering dramatic contrast between towering condensed headlines, technical body typography, and monospace cockpit telemetry.

### Typographic Principles
- **Headlines (`Barlow Condensed`)**: All titles, model classifications, and section leads must be set in uppercase (`text-transform: uppercase`). The tight vertical proportions evoke aggressive speedometers, engine cowls, and bold track banners.
- **Body (`Space Grotesk`)**: Technical yet human, engineered with geometric curves and open counters that remain sharp against high-contrast pitch backgrounds.
- **Labels & Telemetry (`JetBrains Mono`)**: Used for numerical metrics, sensor outputs, transmission gearing, VIN identifiers, and technical switchgear. Monospace guarantees horizontal alignment across fluctuating data points (e.g., RPM counters, lap timers, dynamic torque splits).
- **Authentic Legal Disclaimers (`legal-disclaimer`)**: Micro-precision disclaimers set at 8px monospace in `#8E8E93`. Designed to mimic authentic FIA homologation plaques, homologation chassis stampings, and official factory export documentation.

## Layout & Spacing

Layout geometry is optimized strictly for a 390px baseline mobile viewport (iPhone 14/15/16 Pro standard), enforcing a disciplined, rhythmic vertical cadence.

### Mobile-First Single Column Architecture
- **Viewport Lock**: The experience is strictly single column. Lateral scrolling is prohibited except for dedicated horizontal vehicle telemetry wheels or swipeable bespoke trim swatches.
- **Canvas Edge Margins**: Consistent 20px (`1.25rem`) padding on outer horizontal edges ensures no structural component or dynamic label touches the screen bezel.
- **Grid & Gutters**: Internal modules, specification tables, and split stat indicators use a 2-column or 4-column sub-grid bounded by 16px (`1rem`) gutters.
- **Vertical Spacing Cadence**:
  - `space-xs` (4px): Micro padding between badge icons and technical status tags.
  - `space-sm` (8px): Distance between metadata subtitles and parent headlines.
  - `space-md` (16px): Standard internal padding for cards, switch inputs, and telemetry rows.
  - `space-lg` (24px): Gap separating grouped functional modules.
  - `space-xl` (40px): Section breaks separating narrative chapters, visualizer stages, and vehicle systems.

## Elevation & Depth

This system outright rejects soft blurred shadows, skeuomorphic drops, and organic diffuse elevations. Visual depth is realized strictly through **structural surface tiers and 1px hairline graphite divisions**.

### Depth Layers
- **Tier 0 (Foundation)**: `#000000` — Canvas, full-bleed vehicle photography backdrops, immersive editorial video canvases.
- **Tier 1 (Panels & Trays)**: `#0B0B0B` with `border: 1px solid #222222`. Used for configuration trays, engine spec cards, and persistent bottom bars.
- **Tier 2 (Floating Cockpit Switches)**: `#141414` with `border: 1px solid #333333`. Elevated controls, toggle groups, and active modal overlays.

### Light Emission & Glow
- Zero blur shadows under resting surfaces.
- Active states and drive-mode engagement (e.g., CORSA mode) utilize a surgical 1px luminous border of `#D4AF37` or `#E02424` accompanied by a strictly restrained 0 0 12px perimeter accent glow at 35% opacity.

## Shapes

The shape hierarchy is completely sharp (`roundedness: 0`). Curved radii are antithetical to aggressive carbon-fiber monocoques and precision-milled aeronautic aluminum.

### Geometric Language
- **Zero Radius Everywhere**: Buttons, panels, inputs, chips, and visual frames maintain an absolute 0px border radius. Corners meet at crisp 90-degree right angles.
- **Chamfered Geometries (45° Diagonal Clipped Corners)**: High-priority trigger elements (e.g., Ignition Start/Stop controls, primary CTAs) feature 8px or 12px chamfered corner cuts on opposite diagonal apexes (top-right and bottom-left), directly referencing Italian supercar aerodynamic air intakes and stealth-fighter polygonal architecture.
